up: Find the distinct target names (target_dictionary.pref_name) for assays where the assay organism is exactly 'Canis lupus familiaris'. Join the assays table and target_dictionary table on tid. Return only the distinct target names. Do not apply any row limits or extra filters.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT td.pref_name FROM assays a JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid WHERE a.assay_organism = 'Canis lupus familiaris';
